sentences.span: the September hike marks the beginning of a regime shift or a correction within the current framework. We think it is latter.
sentences.why: No source affirmatively states the first hike was 'the start' of a repricing that continues. GS's GOAL Kickstart describes cross-asset repricing in the past tense (last week), not framed as just beginning. The one source that directly addresses whether the hike marks a 'beginning' (Morgan Stanley/Seth Carpenter) explicitly argues the opposite — it's a correction, not a regime-shift beginning, and they expect less hiking than markets price.

sentences.span: one question is whether the September hike marks the beginning of a regime shift or a correction within the current framework. We think it is latter.
sentences.why: Same claim as s1, continued. The most on-point source rejects the 'beginning' framing for the hike itself.

sentences.span: 10-year Treasury yield reached 5.02%, its highest level since 2007
sentences.why: Live intraday level with no supporting document; the closest research figures for the 10-year that week are 5.02%/5.04%, not 4.99%. A live-market print with no source backing.

sentences.span: Higher demand for computing power should further underpin semiconductor and hardware leaders... this should support demand across processors, memory, advanced packaging, substrates, servers, networking, power systems, and cooling.
sentences.why: The 'hardware order' framing is well supported by UBS. But 'the part of the AI trade with the fewest people arguing against it' is an added consensus claim with no source — no document characterizes this as the least contested part of the AI trade.
searched: hard to argue against / nobody disputes

sentences.span: Apptopia estimated 1.8 million iOS downloads for Muse in the US and Canada, versus 1.3 million for ChatGPT... recording more than 2.5 million downloads in its first 13 days
sentences.why: Download figures match UBS exactly (13-day equivalent period). Meta shares +21% vs SPX +1% since launch matches JPM's Meta note (pilot-data/pilot/source-text/2026-09-23/17526__meta-platforms-inc-the-models-and-agents-are-here-with-muse-.txt: 'Meta shares up 21% since the launch of Muse 2 weeks ago, vs. the SPX +1%').

sentences.span: Samsung HBM4 yields have reportedly reached ~80%, up from below 60% in early mass production... NAND is also improving, with tech specialists pointing to roughly 20% QoQ pricing upside in both 3Q and 4Q
sentences.why: HBM4 yield figures match exactly. NAND flash pricing +20% QoQ in both 3Q and 4Q matches 'rise 20% for a second straight quarter.' Correctly attributed to Goldman.

sentences.span: Less than 30% of S&P stocks are now above the 50-day moving average.
sentences.why: 30% breadth figure matches Goldman note. 'Five sessions running' of more 52-week lows than highs near a record matches BTIG (pilot-data/pilot/source-text/2026-09-23/17474__super-ficial-rally.txt: 'SPX has had five straight days with more 52wk lows than highs even as the index has rallied back near all-time highs').

sentences.span: The CCC minus single-B spread has widened to 799bp, close to the top of its available three-year range
sentences.why: Exact match on figure and range description.

sentences.span: The six-month ATM implied-volatility spread between IWM and SPX has fallen close to the bottom of its two-year range.
sentences.why: Matches 'near a two-year low' framing of IWM vs SPX six-month vol spread.

sentences.span: keep an eye on the diesel exports ban debate, given several Republican lawmakers and candidates intensified calls today for the Trump administration to restrict US diesel exports
sentences.why: Diesel price figures ($6.29, up 68% from $3.74, EIA) are exact (pilot-data/pilot/source-text-all/2026-09-22/17266__inside-commodities-september-21-2026.txt). But 'Trump backed an export ban' misattributes and overstates: sources show Republican lawmakers pushing an unresolved 'debate,' not Trump backing a ban, and Goldman explicitly calls a ban 'unlikely' (pilot-data/pilot/source-text-all/2026-09-22/17521__gs-sector-specialists-energy-natural-resources-and-utilities.txt: 'we think this unlikely given it would not solve medium term global supply issues and is expected to get pushback from US refining industry').

sentences.span: The ICE gasoil crack spread has risen to around $95/bbl this week, up from an average of roughly $74/bbl in August.
sentences.why: Exact figures, correctly attributed to ING.

sentences.span: we think this unlikely given it would not solve medium term global supply issues and is expected to get pushback from US refining industry
sentences.why: No source ties an export ban to compressing the crack-spread/refiner-margin trade specifically as 'the one policy' that does so; this causal framing is not stated anywhere in the source set, and it rests on the already-distorted premise in s10.

sentences.span: This marks the sixth consecutive year the IAEA has revised its projections higher... ~60% of new nuclear capacity could come from SMRs [in North America]
sentences.why: Sixth straight year and ~60% (a majority, i.e. 'most') SMR share of North American capacity both match.

sentences.span: the US-South Korea nuclear power investment agreement is set to be signed on September 18... US$120 bn... 8 US large nuclear reactors
sentences.why: Yuanta forecast signing for Sept 18 (a Friday, confirmed the Friday before this pulse), $120bn, 8 reactors all match. $96.50/lb record uranium price matches a different same-day file (pilot-data/pilot/source-text-all/2026-09-22/17438__takeaways-from-updated-iaea-nuclear-forecast.txt: 'uranium prices at all-time highs at $96.50/lb, vs. the prior high of $95.00/lb in 2007'); Yuanta's own figure is $97/lb, a small figure mismatch versus the parenthetical attribution but the core facts all check out.

sentences.span: To meet demand for nuclear power generation, uranium prices need to rise to US$120/lb, so as to match supply with demand.
sentences.why: Directly matches Yuanta's stated $120/lb level needed to balance supply/demand; the invalidation clause is a reasonable logical inverse of that stated thesis, not a contradicted fact.
